name: @equin/plugin-build-converge
description: Main's deploy, run from outside main's backend: the convergence decision (decideConvergence — is main's own app or a served composition behind a commit it has not attempted?) read from durable state by `./equin build --allow-main --converge`, the run the gateway starts on every advance of refs/heads/main; and the main-deploy-failed report kind the gateway files when that run itself fails.
